# go-modern-time-since

**Since:** Go 1.0

## Summary

Use time.Since(start) instead of time.Now().Sub(start).

## Details

time.Since is the standard spelling for elapsed time from a recorded start.
It keeps the time.Now call inside the time package helper and makes the intent easier to scan.

## Examples

### Before

```go
elapsed := time.Now().Sub(start)
```

### After

```go
elapsed := time.Since(start)
```
